column1: # Non-vendored public revision-pair corpus captured on 2026-08-24.
# Each row compares two genuinely different public revisions of the same document (v_old -> v_new).
# Download both sides into a cache directory as <pair_id>-old.pdf / <pair_id>-new.pdf,
# then validate byte_count and sha256 before comparing. benchmark/realworld/fetch.sh automates this.
# set: dev pairs may inform alignment work; holdout pairs are evaluation-only (SPEC 12.3).
# role: standard pairs sit near pdfdelta's current scope; stress pairs document layout-heavy ceilings
# and must not become the sole quality target.
# in_scope: whether the document type is inside the current product milestone's intended scope.
# expected_extraction: complete requires both sides to extract completely; incomplete records a known
# explicit boundary (unsupported or unresolved) that the comparison must reproduce.
# limit_scale_hint: suggested --limit-scale for large documents; 1.0 keeps documented defaults.
# expected_file: reviewed expected changes relative to this manifest ("-" when none yet).
